//: R9 (Y8) — what each published subpath weighs, and what it is supposed to weigh.
`distBytes` is the gate `src/weight.test.ts` enforces: the summed bytes of the `dist/`
files an entry transitively reaches. It needs no bundler and no network, so it is the
same number on every machine, and it moves the moment a subpath starts reaching for a
module it did not need. A ratchet: a change may not grow one past the value here
without editing this file, which is the review.
`bundledBytes` is R9's own unit — esbuild --bundle --minify --format=esm, one fixture
importing one symbol — recorded rather than gated, because esbuild is not a dependency
of this package and a test that shells out to a binary it does not declare is a check
that passes for the wrong reason on the day it goes missing. `benchmarks/axes/weight.ts`
is where that measurement belongs and where the B4 row must be added; that file is the
integrator lane's, so `y8` below is recorded, not enforced. Reproduce it with the
Read `y8.holds` before quoting any of this: three of the four claims do not.

why: R9 asks for bundled bytes at or under `get-east-asian-width` (3977 bundled, 0 deps,
the lightest thing in this layer). Measured against that bar, one of six entries
clears it: `strip.js` at 966. `index.js` is 6180, which is 1.55x.
Against the weaker and more useful bar `.sdlc/PLAN.md` D1 substitutes — the bundled
bytes of the package each entry actually replaces — one of four holds: `wrap.js` at
6057 (2% over), `slice.js` is 8778 against `slice-ansi` at 5964 (47% over) and
`strip.js` is 966 against `strip-ansi` at 429 (2.3x, on a bundle small enough that
the ratio is not the interesting number).
The measurement is not the whole claim and must not be quoted as if it were: the
incumbent figures above are the bundled bytes of ONE package, and `string-width`
does not ship alone — it carries `strip-ansi`, `ansi-regex` and
`get-east-asian-width`. What a user removes by switching is the tree; what the
bundler keeps after tree-shaking is this. The two answer different questions and
D1 chose the first. Computing it belongs in `benchmarks/axes/weight.ts`, which has
notBuilt: .sdlc/bands/foundation-ceilings.json — R9 names it and it does not exist. Outside
this lane's write paths (`.sdlc/bands/**` belongs to the integrator lane), so the
entry cannot be added from here.
benchmarks/fixtures/entry-points.ts has no `linegauge` pair, so B4 computes no
tree-inclusive ratio for this package. Also the integrator lane's path.
The spawn-delta half of R9 is unmeasured: it needs the B4 harness above.
